Any 2 from: Identifies gravitational force «of the Sun» as causing circular/orbital motion ✓ Identifies orbital radius and orbital period of a planet about the Sun as observable/known quantities ✓ The mass of the Sun/central body is a constant in the equation that relates r and T OR Suggests an equation that combines r, T and M, e.g.  or  ✓   Do not allow a bald statement of Newton’s Law of Gravitation. Do not allow mention of gravitational force unless it is linked to orbital motion.

question.html:
Venus is a planet in the Solar System. The following data are given:

Orbital period of Venus

= 225 days

Orbital period of Earth

= 365 days

a Calculate the ratio . [2]

b Explain how observations of the motion of the planets allow scientists to determine the mass of the Sun. [2]
